title: Quick-fix Yeasty Oven-baked Ethiopian Filo Pastry Pie
description: A traditional Ethiopian filo pastry pie with a twist, featuring a yeasty dough and a unique agave-leaf vessel. Serve warm and enjoy!
instructions: Cut the filonya pastry sheets into 4-6 pieces, depending on the desired size of your pie.
In a bowl, mix together 1/2 cup of warm water, 1 teaspoon of sugar, and 1 teaspoon of active dry yeast. Let it sit for 5-7 minutes until yeast is activated.
Add 2-3 tablespoons of vegetable oil to the yeast mixture and stir well.
Add 1 cup of shredded cabbage, 1 cup of grated carrots, and 1 cup of chopped scallions to the yeast mixture and stir well.
Place 4-6 pieces of filonya pastry sheets in the agave-leaf vessel, overlapping them slightly to create a pie crust.
Pour the yeast mixture into the pie crust and top with additional shredded cabbage and grated carrots if desired.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown and the filling is heated through.
Remove from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
Garnish with chopped scallions and a dollop of yogurt if desired.
